note: First-load JS per route, uncompressed bytes, from .next/diagnostics/route-bundle-stats.json. Each budget is the route as measured at W12 (measured.routes) +2%, rounded up: the ratchet the plan set for W12, down from abb0023's figures +2% (measured.before). Every built route has its own line; a route without one (a page added since) gets defaultRouteBudget, which is the largest page's line after the home page, and gets its own line in the next ratchet. A budget moves only in a commit that says why: a change that goes over reports it in its PR instead of raising its own line. fontsSelfHosted is W2's switch. Checked by scripts/check-bundle-budget.mjs (npm run budget).
